findings.issue: «como que diga» is the colloquial semblative «como que» (as if / apparently) plus subjunctive. כַּאֲשֶׁר plus qal imperfect 3ms licenses a manner clause: as / according as he says or will say.

notes: The rest matches: a three-day way, we will go in the wilderness, and we will sacrifice to Jehová our God, to us.
